say:1:1130920001:1.text: It's not a hard gig or anything... just boring. So boring, in fact, that I'm starting to wonder what it means to be a bounty hunter.
say:1:1130920001:1.source_cn: 不辛苦……只不过是有点无聊，无聊到让我开始思考赏金猎人...

say:2:1130920002:1.text: I suppose it's fine as long as the money's good. At least I'm much better off than those jerks who got tricked into going "treasure hunting."
say:2:1130920002:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，有钱拿就好。和那些被骗去寻宝的人相比，我已...

say:3:1130920003:1.text: Next time I go hunting for treasure, I gotta remember to do it far away from the Adamant Syndicate... and from any snot-nosed kids, too.
say:3:1130920003:1.source_cn: 下次寻宝，我必须得找一个远离黑金……也远离孩子的地方。

say:4:1130920004:1.text: Can you hear the sound of kids crying right now? I think I'm starting to hallucinate...
say:4:1130920004:1.source_cn: 你现在能听到小孩的哭声吗？我觉得我已经开始幻听了……
